component.name: Heft
component.summary: See what is taking the room on a disk or in a folder

description.p: Heft is a disk space analyser. Point it at a disk or a folder and it shows what is taking the room, while the scan is still running: the folders sorted by size, a treemap, the file types, the largest files and how old the space is.

It counts the space a file takes on disk, or its logical size if you prefer. Hard links are counted once, links are not followed, other filesystems are not crossed, and folders that could not be read are counted and named rather than left out of the total.

Deleting moves to the Trash by default; deleting permanently asks a second time, and system folders are refused. A text mode, heft scan, uses the same engine. Nothing about your files leaves the machine.
First release: fast scans, the folder tree, a treemap, file types, largest files and age, delete to Trash, installers and an updater.
